quotes.name: Wilson Shepard
quotes.quote: I've been feeling the energy around Downtown, and I think our fans are really excited for the upcoming season. As the Head Coach of the Oakland Oaks, I'm eager to show the city what we're capable of, and I feel like we're going to catch people off guard this year.

quotes.name: Adash Stanley
quotes.quote: I've felt the excitement building around the Oaks, it's like the whole city is waking up with the team. There's a buzz in the air, and I think people are really looking forward to seeing what they can do this season.

quotes.name: Jessie Hess
quotes.quote: I can feel the energy around Downtown, people are really excited about the Oaks' upcoming season, it's all anyone can talk about when they come in for their coffee.

quotes.name: Dillon Trevor
quotes.quote: I can feel the energy around Downtown, people are really hyped about The Oaks' upcoming season. As someone who's always out in the neighborhood, I've seen how excited the fans are, and it's infectious. I'm looking forward to seeing what the season brings.
